newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Oct 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Major gas importers in Southeast Asia compete to secure enough supplies from Gulf.
- A Yemeni group to build an $8 million water plant in Sanaa, negotiates with Saudi investors to set up a commercial bank in the Yemeni capital.
- Enron, Qatar to start negotiations on Saturday on liquefied natural gas project.
- Three Jordanian companies to raise capital, issue new 25 million shares.
- Saudi's Taiba Investment Co announces a decline in net profit to 21 million riyals in the first nine months of 1996.
